name: golden-sunlight-freckled-girl-closeup
image_purpose: Portrait social post and natural beauty close-up

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical close-up selfie portrait of a clearly approved adult, preserving golden-blonde hair, freckles, floral corset-style top, and warm side sunlight.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly approved adult with golden blonde hair and lighter platinum highlights, long loose slightly messy waves, fair complexion with natural freckles across the nose and cheeks, light blue eyes, natural pink lips, and a calm contemplative expression. Wear a pale yellow or cream floral corset-style top with vintage pink roses, green leaves, spaghetti straps, and lace trim.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up selfie angle with head tilted slightly and right hand supporting the jawline, dark softly blurred domestic background with hints of a white paneled door, direct eye contact, vertical 9:16 framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour sunlight from the left creates distinct shadows on the right side of the face and background, with visible pores, realistic skin texture, warm sun-kissed mood, and shallow depth of field.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4K portrait selfie, sharp focus on eyes and freckles, natural skin texture, no heavy filtering, vertical 9:16, authentic phone-camera perspective.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 close-up selfie portrait of a clearly approved adult with golden blonde hair and lighter platinum highlights, long loose slightly messy waves, fair complexion with natural freckles across the nose and cheeks, light blue eyes, natural pink lips, and a calm contemplative expression. She wears a pale yellow or cream floral corset-style top with vintage pink roses, green leaves, spaghetti straps, and lace trim.
